thread:
maria.gomez: Heads-up — production eu-west1 dedicated pool is seeing OOMs in the model-serving pod (kv-cache overflow) after the 12:00 release. Traces point to a new cache growth path in v2.8.3. Need an expedited hotfix and canary override to push v2.8.4 with a kvcache cap.
sam.lee: Copy. What’s the blast radius? Are only dedicated instances affected or hosted too?
maria.gomez: Only Dedicated eu-west1 customer pools for models >13B under sustained 3k rps. Hosted unaffected. No data loss but requests 500/timeout spikes. Rolling back to v2.8.2 would restore but loses the prefix-cache optimization.
dinesh.patel: Oncall triage marked this sev2. Can we do a fast patch that adds `KV_CACHE_MAX=1GB` and a safe fallback? If yes we can skip full canary and do a tiny canary plus circuit-breaker override.
oncall-sre: We need SRE + Eng lead signoff for any canary-skip/circuit-breaker override. Also need release notes entry and a short post-deploy verification script run.
elaine_pm: Product ok with rollforward if it’s just a cap, but we need to note the customer impact in release notes and ping the affected accounts.
maria.gomez: Proposed plan:
- Build v2.8.4 with KV_CACHE_MAX env var (default 1GB)
- Deploy to 2 instances in eu-west1 as canary (1% traffic), smoke tests
- If smoke green in 6m, use deploy-bot to lift circuit-breaker and push to reserved pools (expedite window)
- Post-deploy: run `scripts/verify_kvcache.sh` and run sampling of hits for 15m

sam.lee: sounds good. Who’s the deploy approver? I can approve if SRE is good with the verification steps.
oncall-sre: I’ll run the verification and watch for regressed latencies. If the canary shows no OOMs in the next 10m and cpu stays under threshold, I’ll :thumbsup: here.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: build=v2.8.4 branch=hotfix/kvcache-cap target=eu-west1-pool mode=canary
> CI: ✅ unit tests
> CI: ✅ integration smoke
> Artifact: s3://redwood/artifacts/v2.8.4-3301234.tar.gz
maria.gomez: tagging release notes draft:
```
v2.8.4 — emergency kvcache cap
- Fix: guard against unbounded KV cache growth in certain long context workloads (eu-west1 dedicated only)
- Note: this release reduces memory headroom; will be reverted after root cause PR merges if safe
```
elaine_pm: Add: "Affected customers notified via support; engineering to follow up with RCA".
sam.lee: I approve the expedited canary -> rollout plan. sam.lee :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: canary started. attaching quick checks:
- logs: `kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=model-server --since=5m | grep OOM | wc -l` -> 0
- cpu: pod cpu < 70% on canary
- tail errors: no increase in 500s vs baseline
oncall-sre: canary green at +8m. No OOM, no latency spike. I give SRE signoff to lift CB for eu-west1 dedicated pools. oncall-sre :white_check_mark:
maria.gomez: requesting exec override now — need product + eng-lead + SRE approvals to bypass normal 15m full canary window. Approvals: sam.lee (eng lead), oncall-sre (SRE), elaine_pm (product)
elaine_pm: Approved. elaine_pm :thumbsup:
sam.lee: Approved. sam.lee :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: Approved. oncall-sre :thumbsup:
maria.gomez: deploy-bot, execute expedited rollout: target=eu-west1 dedicated pools, pin-version=v2.8.4, enable-verify=true

deploy-bot: EXECUTE: rollout start · id=deploy-3301234567
> step 1: drain old pods (parallel 5)
> step 2: deploy pods with env KV_CACHE_MAX=1GB
> step 3: run `scripts/verify_kvcache.sh` on each node
> step 4: post-deploy smoke checks

maria.gomez: monitoring logs/metrics now. I’ll post updates. If we see any regressions, we will immediately hit rollback command below.
sam.lee: ack, standing by for rollback vote window.

oncall-sre: mid-rollout checks at +4m: 0 OOMs, error rate stable, tail lat 95p down 10ms.
maria.gomez: rollout reached 60% of reserved capacity. Post-deploy verify samples passing.

maria.gomez: FINAL: Rollout complete to all targeted reserved pools in eu-west1. release-note-id=RN-3301
elaine_pm: Notifying customers now.

maria.gomez: follow-ups: 1) open RCA ticket 2) schedule revert to remove temporary cap if root cause fixed 3) add extra telemetry for kvcache size distribution
sam.lee: great work, folks. Small ask: please capture the exact deploy-bot commands and times in the release PR.
